notes: New: Smerv, the prompt engineer. Type or say what you want, and Smerv turns it into a detailed, step-by-step prompt. Copy it, or send it to any agent in the project or to a new one. Open it from the dock, from the New Agent window or with Ctrl+K, or by voice ("open Smerv", "send Smerv's prompt to Dave"). Smerv's own engine is free, instant and works offline. It can also refine with a local model (Ollama/LM Studio) or a Council seat. Quick Council requests are now much faster, and Codex seats no longer fail with "Not inside a trusted directory".
